```sql
WITH 
  attendance_2023 AS (
    SELECT * FROM "attendance_2023"
  ),
  attendance_2024 AS (
    SELECT * FROM "attendance_2024"
  ),
  centre_turnout AS (
    SELECT 
      Centre,
      AVG(Avg Daily Present) AS avg_turnout_2023,
      AVG(Average attendance) AS avg_turnout_2024
    FROM attendance_2023
    JOIN attendance_2024 ON Centre = centre_name
    GROUP BY Centre
  ),
  turnout_change AS (
    SELECT 
      Centre,
      (avg_turnout_2024 - avg_turnout_2023) * 100 / NULLIF(avg_turnout_2023, 0) AS turnout_change
    FROM centre_turnout
  )
SELECT 
  Centre,
  turnout_change
FROM turnout_change
ORDER BY turnout_change DESC;
```
